title: Ordinal sizes
summary: Use a masculine ordinal with розмір. In compound ordinals only the last word declines. These are Ukrainian labels, not an international size conversion.

38.c0.note: Nominative: the ordinal names the size itself.

38.c1.note: Genitive: after розміру the ordinal takes the genitive.
